task_contract: Record or revise the task contract: goal, assumptions, done-criteria (each with an optional executable check), and the irreversible actions you expect. Required before any action that changes something, and before completing.
task_complete: Report the task done. Every criterion is then checked against the world; if a check fails you get the failure back and the task stays open.
task_fail: Declare that you cannot finish the task, with the reason and what you observed.
ask_principal: Ask the person a question and wait for the answer. Use only when an assumption changes the outcome or an action cannot be undone.
propose_policy: Propose a policy change (Cedar rules for a layer such as org or user/<id>) to the person who owns that layer, citing evidence. It changes nothing until they accept it.
wait_until: Pause the task until a time (RFC 3339), for example to wait for a reply or a scheduled moment.
notify: Send the person a short note without waiting for an answer.
web_fetch: Fetch a web page or file by URL and return its text.
web_search: Search the web and return result titles, URLs and snippets.
memory_write: Remember a fact for future tasks, with an optional topic.
memory_search: Search facts remembered from earlier tasks.
sandbox_exec: Run a shell command in your private Linux workspace (Python 3 with document, spreadsheet, slide and PDF libraries). It has no network. Files persist under /workspace for this task.
sandbox_write_file: Write a file into your workspace. Set base64 true for binary content.
sandbox_read_file: Read a file from your workspace. Binary files come back base64-encoded.
